title: advertiser.v2
description: advertisers@2 (pairwise edges; analyst spec 2026-11-08), ONE record per ad, written by `derive-advertisers --method v2` to derived/advertisers_v2.jsonl next to v1's advertisers.jsonl (v1 unchanged). advertiser_id is a hash of the component's ad set: not stable across crawls, so join on ad_id.

level.description: operator iff size>=5 AND names>=3 AND (top_shared_key_share>=0.5 OR names>=5): a judgement threshold

edge_evidence.description: the kinds of the v2 edges that pulled this ad in; [] for a singleton

operator_id.description: the v2 component (operator level): a hash of its ad set, not stable across crawls

persona_id.description: the component over persona edges only (a shared non-email handle, or a name + another kind); always inside one operator

persona_edge_evidence.description: the kinds of the persona edges that pulled this ad in; [] for a singleton persona
